purpose: Three close standing leaf-healer costume alternatives preserving identity and palette.

records.label: A 叠叶披肩
records.prompt:
Create ONE close COSTUME DESIGN VARIANT of this same youthful leaf-healer girl for the GameXXK cast. Lock her identity, green bob/blunt fringe, two large sprout leaves, two green side locks/white pom-poms, violet eyes and warm little smile, current compact head/body proportions, calm grounded standing pose, both feet down, gathered hands, three-quarter left orientation and current overall framing. Keep SAME green/ivory/charcoal/dull-gold palette with limited red cloth accents, white fully opaque leg coverings and red flat shoes. Preserve youthful wholesome presentation and complete modest outfit, no adult body shaping or increased exposure. No new props, gourd, staff, basket, floating effects or hairstyle change.
Vary only shoulder/collar/cuffs/waist and skirt tailoring, broad leaf motifs and simple fastening design as specified. Must remain recognizably the SAME character, with original large-leaf silhouette.
Project GEM ICON painting: confident dark-green/ink contours, substantial broad form-defining matte planes, 2–3 main values per material, restrained wide brush shapes. Reduce existing tiny hair facets into larger masses, no granular texture, fragmented triangle mosaic, glossy crystal look or realistic eyes. Full figure including leaves and shoes inside square warm ivory background with clear margins. No text, badge, title, scenery or contact sheet. VARIANT A — 叠叶披肩. Replace the tiny dark shoulder corners with a short green capelet made from exactly THREE large overlapping leaf panels, ivory turned edges and one small red tie at center. Keep the white crossover collar and black central tabard with one gold sprout emblem. Waist uses a plain dark-green band, red ties shortened to two neat broad ends. Green skirt made of three broad leaf-shaped overlapping panels over a modest continuous ivory underskirt; hem lobes are large and few. White sleeves remain wide and drape downward, cuffs have a clean angled leaf-tip cut rather than numerous scallops. Same standing pose, hands, hair and palette. Emphasize long broad leaf curves and layering, not extra tiny leaves everywhere.
